title: Maira’s Dream · Second Chances
author: the internet slop warehouse
description: First playable thrift-store dream: three randomized errands, a $30 budget, nine tagged purchases, inspect/take/return, staffed cash checkout with receipt, risky tag switching and a sad gray clown manager. Motion-sensor sliding doors lead to four match-wielding black cats, fire patches, usable extinguishers and an escape to your car. First-person desktop/touch controls, pause and retry. Original low-poly art. Initial slice: customer figures do not yet queue; office ending is a result card.

title: Maira’s Dream · design and asset plan
author: the internet slop warehouse
description: Warehouse discovery inventory, first-slice shopping/escape design, original model inventory, layout, source conventions, validation and follow-up roadmap.

title: Retail game environments · fire-safety design notes
author: the internet slop warehouse
description: Primary-source OSHA research for fictional retail environments: accessible extinguisher distribution, clear egress and separate emergency exit. Explicitly distinguishes game design from local building-code compliance; researched 2026-11-15.
